2026-10-29.body: There is a specific kind of attention in writing about the justify part the way you did. There is a quiet discipline in noticing one thing properly instead of ten things barely, and most people skip straight past it. What comes next for you with this?
You put words on something I have seen but never named, that lunch thread. Recipes travel like dialects. Same dish, different household, different rules. What did this replace in your kitchen?

The montage angle here deserves a second reading. The ordinary days carry most of the weight and almost none of the stories, and the piece earns that reading. What does the good version of this day look like?

Tue Oct 20.body: You went straight at the the completely part, so here is the rest of that thought. Recipes travel like dialects. Same dish, different household, different rules, and that is the piece I would add to your point. What did this replace in your kitchen?
